title: Raise The Stakes
tagline: About The "RaiseTheStakes" game contract is a suitable for games or applications where players can participate, earn rewards, and interact with their in-game assets.
description: Raise The Stakes is an SAS prototype utilizing GHO to incorporate staking and seamless cross-chain integration experiences for developers, gamers and other Web3 users.  This prototype facilitates developer experience and enables both developers and game players alike to safely benefit from extensive Web3 technology use and integration opportunities without having to be experts in Web3 technology to do so!
how_its_made: Raise The Stakes prototype utilizes Solidity, Typescript, GHO, CCIP, Tailwind and Web3js but is not limited to those. There is flexibility in the Raise The Stake's design that accommodates new protocol upgrades, features and cross-chain opportunities; the Github Repo and Demo video included in the project submission will dive into more specific details.
